description: This file defines the ServiceRegistry class, which manages the registration and lookup of service handles within a Java-based system. It maintains a registry of services by IPC and event ports, generating a unique process identifier, and provides methods for registering services and retrieving service handles based on ports.

classes.name: ServiceRegistry
classes.description: A singleton-like class that maintains a registry of services available within the system, allowing registration and lookup based on IPC and event ports. It generates a pseudo-unique process ID per JVM instance.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a service handle in the registry, associating it with its IPC and event ports.

methods.name: getServiceForIpcPort
methods.description: Retrieves the service handle associated with a given IPC port.

methods.name: getServiceForEventPort
methods.description: Retrieves the service handle associated with a given event port.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the process ID and the concurrent hash map for service lookup; called once per JVM to set up the registry.

methods.name: getProcessIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique process identifier for this JVM instance.
